desc: Implement `Solution.minLength` with binary search over L in [1, n]; check(L) = sum of run_length // (L+1) for L >= 2, and for L == 1 compute min Hamming distance to "0101..." and "1010..."
Validate against Example 1 ("000001", 1 -> 2), Example 2 ("0000", 2 -> 1), Example 3 ("0101", 0 -> 1), and edge cases: n == 1, numOps == 0, all characters equal, numOps == n
Confirm the L == 1 special case is correct (alternating pattern Hamming distance)
Verify off-by-one in floor(m/(L+1)): m=3,L=2 -> 1; m=4,L=2 -> 1; m=5,L=2 -> 1 (confirmed achievable via two pieces of size 2)
Final integration review: single-pass O(n log n) complexity, monotone feasibility, correct handling when L=1 is already satisfied with 0 flips
